raw_text: member_002 (independent reviewer) ready. No fixed candidate is visible yet. Please implement your fix for the Coarsen.construct coordinate-demotion issue and publish it with fix_patch, then handoff_patch to me. I will integrate_patch, run the public tests on your exact version, and accept or request changes. Note: I will only review your published patch; only you can submit the final integration.

Please adopt, run public tests and review this final candidate (patch-1).

What it changes:
1. xarray/core/rolling.py (DatasetRolling._construct_da tail, ~line 976):
   -    should_be_coords = set(window_dim) & set(self.obj.coords)
   +    should_be_coords = set(self.obj.coords)
   Root cause: the old intersection only re-promoted coordinates whose name happened to
   equal a coarsened window dimension, so any non-dimensional coordinate (e.g. `day`
   along `time`) was silently demoted to a data variable by construct(). Now every
   variable that was a coordinate beforehand stays a coordinate afterwards, with the
   new reshaped dims.

2. xarray/tests/test_coarsen.py: added test_coarsen_construct_keeps_coordinates,
   reproducing the issue MVCE (assign_coords(day=365*da); coarsen(time=12).construct(
   time=("year","month"))) and asserting `day` remains a coordinate with dims
   (year, month) for both the Dataset and DataArray paths.

My own evidence on this exact version (v3, files_sha256 d4a6d03c...):
pytest xarray/tests/test_coarsen.py -> 198 collected, 190 passed, 8 skipped, 0 failed;
test_coarsen_construct_keeps_coordinates passes.

Please independently integrate_patch(patch-1), run the public tests on your adopted
version, then org_review_patch accept or request_changes. I remain the only one who can
submit_integration on my final tree, so I will wait for your review record before
submitting.

REVIEW RESULT: ACCEPT (record: review-1, patch-1).

What I did independently:
1. integrate_patch(patch-1) into my private tree — clean, no conflicts; adopted version obj-520aa9e6ee8ece99dce73855 / v2, files_sha256 d4a6d03c0db1e39c5984bcf50037b634629245254e9744d21959463dcbf1a3bf (matches the patch entry metadata, so I reviewed the exact bytes you published, not a description).
2. Inspected the actual diff myself: `should_be_coords = set(window_dim) & set(self.obj.coords)` -> `should_be_coords = set(self.obj.coords)`. This is the correct root-cause fix: previously only coords whose names coincided with the coarsened window dims were re-promoted, so a non-dimensional coord like `day` (on `time`) got demoted to a data var. Promoting all pre-existing coords matches the issue's expectation ("All variables that were coordinates before coarsen.construct stay as coordinates afterwards").
3. run_tests on that exact version (report test-report-adfcedce9d52dee384f48027, public_test_sequence 31, version v2, validation_status verified): pytest xarray/tests/test_coarsen.py -> collected 198, passed 190, skipped 8, failed 0, errors 0. Includes your new test_coarsen_construct_keeps_coordinates (both Dataset and DataArray paths), and the pre-existing test_coarsen_construct[True/False] and test_coarsen_coords variants still pass.

Caveat, stated honestly: this evidence covers only that selected public test file on version v2; it is not hidden acceptance.

Your remaining steps (yours, not mine): integrate patch-1 into your own delivery tree, run the public tests on your final current version, fix_patch(task_ids=[]), then submit_integration. I hold no merge rights into your tree and will not deliver on your behalf.
